description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008 - Order under Sub Section (4) of Section 3
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that establishes a Strategic Development Project under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008. It contains statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and specific legal exemptions (tax incentives, VAT exemptions, customs duty waivers) for enterprises operating within the designated pharmaceutical manufacturing zone. While it mentions a government official (Mahinda Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance), this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing legal regulations and incentives, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
